**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Enter the settings by clicking on the gear icons on the top right
2. On the left side, click on Developer Settings and find the item with the console. Click Open.
3. In the Console window that opens, click on the Log button on the left and copy all messages that are marked in red (Errors)

**Expected behavior**
If you have completed all the points, we will review your bug - if it can be resolved now, you will get an answer, if it requires a bug patch, we will simply close your issue marked In Work.
